Yes—**it appears suitable for sensitive baby skin**, *assuming you mean the Bc Babycare “Cloud Moist Baby Wipes” 3-pack / 240 count listing*. I couldn’t verify a product specifically branded **“Wiggle & Snug Cloud Wipes”**, but the 3-pack “Cloud Moist” wipes are listed as **hypoallergenic**, **unscented**, **recommended for sensitive skin**, and **safe to use on sensitive skin**. Target’s product details also say they contain **99% purified water**, are **0 alcohol / 0 fragrance / 0 parabens / 0 dyes**, and are **dermatologist-tested**. ([target.com](https://www.target.com/p/-/A-1006780196))

A couple of cautions: babies can still react to a specific preservative or ingredient even when wipes are marketed as sensitive/hypoallergenic. The AAP advises checking ingredients if your child has allergies or sensitive skin, and recommends alcohol- and fragrance-free wipes for diaper-rash prevention. ([publications.aap.org](https://publications.aap.org/aapnews/news/16696/How-to-use-disposable-wipes-safely?utm_source=openai))

**Practical recommendation:** Try them on a small area first, stop using if redness/rash worsens, and for active irritation consider plain water + soft cloth until skin calms. Also, **do not flush** these wipes.
